parsed.rationale: Both `HandleINIntent` and `SiriIntentDonated` are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same file (`Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/Events/IntentEvents.swift`) within the `Analytics` package, but they carry distinct names that encode different domain events (handling an intent vs. donating a Siri intent). The structural similarity (shared_field_count: 1, both empty fields_or_signature) reflects only that both are zero-field type aliases, not that they represent the same concept. Collapsing or deduplicating them would conflate two semantically distinct analytics events, which is undesirable regardless of their structural coincidence.
